label: Visual
tagline: Images, icons, illustrations, decorative ambient motion
description: Classifies every visual slot (img, background-image, canvas, declared shader/lottie/3d paths) by medium and dispatches one per-medium drawer per slot. Modes: HTML-enumeration (post source-write) and Bare Intent (chat-triggered ad-hoc image requests). Step 8 QA checks style coherence + composition + cutout + text contrast after assets land.

triggers.title: Path A — "build an app/page" with visual slots
triggers.rule: After source HTML is scaffolded (by /prototype skill or top-level Claude), dispatch visual-planner against the source tree for HTML-enumeration. The planner enumerates / background-image / canvas / inline-svg slots and dispatches one per-medium drawer per slot.

triggers.title: Path B — Bare intent
triggers.rule: User says "make me an image of X", "generate an icon", "give me a shader" etc. Dispatch visual-planner in Bare Intent mode for a single asset; planner picks the medium and generator skill.
